parameters.n: Common cardinality of each set input x in X, not the size of the ambient indicator cube.
parameters.c: Minimum positive |x minus y| over distinct x,y in X.
parameters.Delta: Maximum number of allowed queries mentioning a universe element.
parameters.M: Largest threshold <=n such that every pair of conflicting partial inputs, each of size <=M, is separated by a query.
parameters.beta: Largest factor guaranteeing at least beta*|x minus y| distinct z_j with x minus z_j strictly contained in x minus y and pairwise disjoint y minus z_j.
parameters.beta_c: Same shortening condition as beta, requiring |y minus z_j|=c.
parameters.alpha: A witnessing parameter: degree-d pseudo-characters induce Boolean cubes of dimension at least alpha*d.

profiles.queries: Reveal the partner of a vertex.
Reveal the hyperedge containing a vertex.
profiles.caveat: Fresh repository degree descent gives degree_H<=(2k-1)^2s_H^2 after independently checking and correcting the imported permutation cubes. The existing D<=10368*(2k-1)^10*s_H^10 query lift remains valid. These retain k-dependent coefficients and do not establish an intrinsic alpha-witnessing parameter; prior general publication is not certified.

profiles.domain: M(lambda): words with fixed color multiplicities
profiles.caveat: Do not divide by M when min(lambda)=1. Uniform polynomial equivalence is asserted for balanced multislices, or the source low-complexity conditions.
The balanced-slice theorem is not an unrestricted promise theorem. Full-slice improvements also appear in HKMP26.

warnings: Composability and alpha-witnessing are separate assumptions.
All parameter values are source bounds unless explicitly exact.
No uniform scalar upper bound is inferred by dropping n/M, Delta, beta or alpha.
